# The admin listener's only ingress (admin identity design D1 "Admin
# ingress", §8 C11): a NodePort on the node's WireGuard address. Required
# node setting: kube-proxy nodeport-addresses=10.44.0.1/32, so the port binds
# nowhere else (docs/runbooks/admin-plane.md). externalTrafficPolicy Local
# keeps the operator's address as the TCP peer; NetworkPolicy
# allow-admin-tunnel admits only 10.44.0.2/32, and the app checks the peer
# again. policy/kubernetes.rego allows exactly this Service and no other
# NodePort. Endpoint: http://10.44.0.1:30843.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vuoro-control-admin
  namespace: vuoro-system
  labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vuoro-control-admin}
spec:
  type: NodePort
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  selector: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vuoro-control-admin}
  ports:
    - {name: admin, protocol: TCP, port: 8443, targetPort: 8443, nodePort: 30843}
